verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud SaaS work-management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where Trello stores customer data. The community threads about account migration and data loss concern account management, not storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
